app.name: School Management System
app.tagline: For schools and colleges in Bangladesh

home.title: Welcome
home.mainSite: Main site: super admin and product info

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.description: There is no school or page at this address. Please check the address.

auth.identifier: Email, mobile number or Student ID
auth.schoolLogin: Teacher, staff and student sign in

errors.required: Enter your email/mobile/Student ID and password.
errors.invalid: Those sign-in details are not correct.
errors.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {minutes, number} minutes.
errors.inactive: This account is switched off. Please contact the school office.
errors.noSchool: No school was found at this address.
errors.schoolClosed: This school's account is currently closed. Please contact the service provider.
errors.studentLoginOff: Login is off for students of your class. Log in with your guardian's mobile or contact the school.

dashboard.comingText: Today's attendance, fee collection and dues will appear here. Start from the menu on the left; items marked "Soon" arrive in the next steps.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: After a change you are signed out on every other device.
changePassword.firstLogin: This is your first sign-in. Please set your own password now.
changePassword.rules: At least {min, number} characters, with both letters and numbers.

errors.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
errors.tooShort: The password must be at least {min, number} characters.
errors.tooCommon: That password is too easy to guess. Choose another.
errors.sameAsOld: The new password must differ from the old one.
errors.mismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
errors.noUser: Account not found. Please sign in again.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email, mobile number or Student ID. We'll send a 6-digit code.
forgotPassword.identifier: Email, mobile number or Student ID
forgotPassword.codeSent: If this account exists, a code was sent for "{identifier}". It is valid for 10 minutes.
forgotPassword.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.

errors.required: Enter your email, mobile number or Student ID.
errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new code and try again.
errors.schoolClosed: This school's account is currently closed. Please contact the service provider.

plans.title: Plans
plans.empty: No plans yet. Start with "New plan".

fields.name: Plan name
fields.isActive: Offer this plan to new schools

errors.name: Use 2 to 60 characters.
errors.nameTaken: Another plan already has this name.
errors.price: Enter a valid price, e.g. 1500 or 1500.50.
errors.maxStudents: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100,000.

schools.title: Schools
schools.empty: No schools yet. Start with "New school".
schools.noPlans: You need at least one active plan first.
schools.adminHint: This admin gets a temporary password and must change it at first login. Give an email or a mobile number (at least one).

errors.code: Use 2–40 lowercase English letters, digits or - (reserved words like www, admin are not allowed).
errors.codeTaken: Another school already uses this code.
errors.name: Name must be 2 to 120 characters.
errors.board: Pick a board from the list.
errors.phone: Enter a valid mobile number, e.g. 01712345678.
errors.adminContact: Give the admin an email or a mobile number.

created.title: {name} is ready
created.description: Classes, groups, grade scale, fee types, SMS templates, the current session and a trial subscription were created.
created.warning: This password will never be shown again. Copy it now and give it to the head teacher. They must set a new password at first login.

statusHelp.ACTIVE: Everyone at the school can log in and work as usual.
statusHelp.SUSPENDED: Paused: nobody can log in, and logged-in users are signed out. Data is kept.
statusHelp.CLOSED: The school left the service: site shut, data is never deleted.

statusErrors.reason: Write a reason (at least 3 characters) to suspend or close.

subs.overlapHint: If an older subscription is still running, it ends when this one starts. The end date follows the plan; you can change it.
subs.noSubForPayment: Add a subscription before taking a payment.
subs.watchHint: Schools whose subscription ends within {days, number} days, has ended, or is missing.

errors.endBeforeStart: The end date can't be before the start date.
errors.amount: Enter a valid amount, e.g. 1500 or 1500.50.
errors.future: A payment can't be dated in the future.

schoolProfile.title: School profile
schoolProfile.hint: The name, address, logo and signature here appear on marksheets, receipts and ID cards.
schoolProfile.codeNote: School code: {code} (contact the service provider to change it)

errors.name: Name must be 2 to 120 characters.
errors.board: Pick a board from the list.
errors.phone: Enter a valid mobile number, e.g. 01712345678.
errors.division: Pick a division from the list.
errors.district: Pick a district of this division.

upload.formats: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to {mb, number} MB. Big images are shrunk automatically.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: A square logo looks best. Shown on the login page, receipts and marksheets.

signature.title: Head teacher's signature
signature.hint: Sign in black ink on white paper, then photograph or scan it. Only logged-in staff can see it.

errors.tooBig: The image is too big; use less than {mb, number} MB.
errors.notImage: This is not a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this.
errors.failed: Upload failed. Check the internet and try again.

generalSettings.title: General settings
generalSettings.hint: The school's language, days off, student login and automatic SMS.
generalSettings.languageHint: People see the school site in this language the first time. Everyone can switch it for themselves.
generalSettings.holidaysHint: No attendance is taken on these days. Up to 3 days.
generalSettings.studentHint: For younger classes, guardians log in with their mobile number instead.
generalSettings.studentCanSeeFees: Students can see their own fees and dues
generalSettings.studentCanSeeFeesHint: When off, only guardians see fees.
generalSettings.smsHint: SMS goes to the guardian's mobile automatically (uses SMS credit).
generalSettings.smsOnPayment: When a fee is paid (with receipt number)

errors.holidays: No more than 3 days off a week.
errors.studentLogin: Pick a class from the list.

sessions.title: Academic sessions
sessions.hint: Admissions, attendance, exams and fees all belong to a session. Each type has one "current" session.

typeHints.COLLEGE: Dates set by the school, named like "2026-27".

sessions.currentNote: Changing the current session sends new admissions, attendance and fees to that session. Older sessions keep all their data. A session that has data can't be deleted.

errors.noCollege: This school has no higher secondary level, so it can't have college sessions.
errors.typeLocked: A session's type can't change after it is created.
errors.name: Name must be 2 to 20 characters.
errors.nameTaken: Another session of this type has this name.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date must be after the start date.
errors.tooLong: A session can't be longer than 2 years.
errors.deleteCurrent: The current session can't be deleted.
errors.deleteInUse: This session has data, so it can't be deleted.

classes.title: Classes
classes.hint: Classes follow the national order (Play to Twelve). You can rename them, switch them on/off and choose whether Classes 9–12 have groups.
classes.name: Name
classes.editHint: {level}, order {order, number}. The order can't change: promotion moves students to the next one.
classes.orderNote: Promotion uses the order to find the next class, so it can't change. Switch off classes the school doesn't teach; a class with students this session can't be switched off.
classes.addLevelHint: When the school starts a new level (e.g. a college section), all its classes are added at once.

groups.title: Groups
groups.hint: Science, Humanities, Business Studies, etc. Only for Classes 9–12.
groups.noGroupClasses: No class has groups switched on. Turn them on for Classes 9–12 on the Classes page.
groups.name: Name
groups.newHint: For example Agriculture or Home Science.

academicForm.hasGroupsHint: Sections and subjects are split by Science/Humanities/Business.

academicErrors.name: Name must be 1 to 40 characters.
academicErrors.nameTaken: Another one already has this name.
academicErrors.groupedSections: This class has sections split by group, so groups can't be switched off.
academicErrors.classHasStudents: This class has students this session, so it can't be switched off.
academicErrors.groupInUse: This group has sections or students, so it can't be switched off.
academicErrors.sectionHasStudents: This section has students this session, so it can't be switched off.
academicErrors.sectionUsed: This section has been used, so it can't be deleted. Switch it off instead.
academicErrors.class: Its class is switched off; switch the class on first.

sectionsPage.title: Sections
sectionsPage.hint: Each section = class + name + version + shift (+ group in Classes 9–12). Admission and attendance go by section.
sectionsPage.name: Name
sectionsPage.namesHint: Separate with commas to create several at once.
sectionsPage.newHint: Pick a class and name the sections.

errors.class: Pick a class that is switched on.
errors.names: Give 1 to 10 names, each up to 20 characters.
errors.group: Pick a group that is switched on.
errors.exists: This class, version and shift already has a section named "{names}".
errors.groupHasStudents: This section has students this session, so its group can't change.
errors.capacityBelow: It already has {count, number} students; seats can't be fewer.
